categories.name: Wigs & Frontal Services
categories.description: Transcribed from client's existing booking-page screenshots. Some durations look like placeholders (1 min / 5 min / 10 min) rather than real appointment lengths — flagged below for client confirmation.

services.name: Frontal Ponytail
services.notes: Client provides: 1 bundle for a bun (14–16in), 2 bundles for a ponytail, 14–16in 13x6 HD frontal only. No transparent lace / dense frontals. Hair must be freshly washed and completely product-free.

services.name: Hair Included Frontal Ponytail
services.notes: Includes ponytail installation, 2x20in bundles (longer lengths available as paid add-on), 14in 13x6 HD frontal only. Hair must be freshly washed and completely product-free.

services.name: Custom Frontal Unit
services.notes: Includes bleaching, wig construction (bundles + frontal sewn onto dome mesh cap), customisation, installation, styling. Head measurements required. Hair must be sent 5 days before appointment or a £10 fee applies. If purchasing hair from the salon, book slot a minimum of 10 days in advance. (Source listing was titled 'Costum Frontal Unit' — likely a typo for 'Custom'.)

services.name: Frontal Replacement With Installation
services.notes: Replacement of frontal/closure unit + installation. Wig/bundle revamp available as a separate add-on.

services.name: Pre-Made Frontal/Closure (Factory Made)
services.notes: Includes install, bleaching knots, plucking, basic styling.

services.name: Frontal Replacement Only
services.notes: Frontal replacement only. Wig revamp available as add-on. FLAG: 10-minute duration seems too short for the described work — confirm actual time needed with client.

services.name: Wig Making (Non-Contact)
services.notes: Fits to exact head size. Lace/V/half wig, bundles or bundles+closure sewn onto dome mesh cap. Head measurements required. Drop off hair 5 days before pick-up. FLAG: 1-minute duration is almost certainly a placeholder/booking-slot artifact from the old system, not the real turnaround time — confirm real duration and whether £60 is a deposit or the full price.

services.name: Wig Customisation
services.notes: Includes bleaching, plucking, basic styling. Choose a slot 5 days prior to pick-up time. Hair must be sent 5 days before appointment or a £10 fee applies. FLAG: 5-minute duration likely a placeholder — confirm real duration.

services.name: Closure Sew In
services.notes: Book for any type of closure sew in. Includes cornrows, weaving net, bleaching, plucking, lace installation/hair left out, basic styling. Client provides closure of chosen size + minimum 3 bundles. Closure must be dropped off 5 days before appointment or a £10 fee applies.

services.name: Custom U/V/Half Wig
services.notes: Construction of a U/V/half wig unit using client head measurements; installation and styling included; wig is reusable. Includes construction, cornrows, blending natural hair into extensions, basic styling. Hair must be dropped off 5 days before appointment. If ordering hair from the salon's collection, book a minimum of 10 days prior.

services.name: Bougie Set
services.notes: Dramatic mega-volume wispy set, up to 25MM. FLAG: source description refers to this style as 'Roman' — confirm correct service name/description with client.

services.name: Glam Set
services.notes: Soft, natural everyday look with a subtle doll-eye effect. Not a cat-eye look — switching to cat-eye mid-appointment may change the price.

services.name: Foreign Infills
services.notes: For infills on lash sets not originally done by Bougie Hair & Beauty. Client must have at least 50% of lashes remaining, otherwise charged as a full set.

services.name: Luxe Set
services.notes: Cat-eye volume set for an everyday look, up to 20MM. FLAG: source description refers to this style as 'the queen set' — confirm correct service name/description with client.

services.name: Infills
services.notes: Infills for Bougie Hair & Beauty's own lash work.
